subject: Re: Next steps — POC eval prompts & dataset handoff for Horizon Analytics
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@horizon-analytics.com>; Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@horizon-analytics.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Mar 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: POC Kickoff: Prompt/eval dataset requirements & timeline

Jordan / Priya — thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the POC materials ingested next week.

Summary of what we discussed:
- Goal / success criteria: Reduce endpoint hallucination rate on Horizon’s clinical note summarization flow by 40% vs baseline while meeting median latency < 350ms at 95th percentile for the selected model profile. Also preserve clinical fidelity (no dropped diagnoses) in > 98% of summaries.
- Evaluation plan: Redwood will run an automated eval using the prompt set + representative logs you provide. We will compute precision/recall-like metrics for entity preservation, hallucination rate (measured by presence of unsupported facts), and token-level latency/cost.
- Data handoff: Horizon to provide (a) prompt set / test cases, (b) a ~500–1,000 sample of historical anonymized requests (inputs) and expected/desired outputs where available.

What we need from Horizon by EOD Wed, Mar 18:
1) Prompt set CSV (columns: prompt_id, prompt_text, expected_output_optional, intent_tag) — see attached template.
2) Sample logs (anonymized) in JSONL or CSV. Please redact patient identifiers; see brief guidance below.
3) One primary POC owner (name/email) and any technical contact for S3/Share access.

Redaction guidance (high level):
- Remove direct identifiers (names, MRNs) or replace with consistent tokens (e.g., [PATIENT_1]).
- Keep clinical context (symptoms, meds, dates relative like ‘3 days ago’ are OK).
- Do not include raw PHI in unencrypted email attachments.

Logistics / timeline we propose:
- Mar 18: Horizon provides artifacts.
- Mar 19: Intake and validation by Redwood (Vivek will coordinate ingestion).
- Mar 20–24: Run evals and share preliminary dashboards and examples.
- Mar 25: Review findings, recommend model/quantization/latency tuning levers and next steps for a production pilot.

Ownership at Redwood: Marissa (AE) — commercial lead; Vivek (SE) — ingestion/eval engine owner; Sean (CS) — success and change management.

Attachments: prompt template (CSV) and a mutual action plan draft.

Ask: please confirm ownership and whether Horizon prefers S3 upload (we can provide a pre-signed bucket) or a secure Drive folder. If you have any concerns about the redaction guidance, flag them and we’ll iterate.

Thanks — looking forward to the handoff.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
[Attachment: prompt_template_v1.csv (CSV, 2KB)]
[Attachment: mutual_action_plan_Horizon_POC.docx (DOCX, 14KB)]

From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@horizon-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@horizon-analytics.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff: Prompt/eval dataset requirements & timeline

Marissa — really appreciate the clear recap. Priya and I reviewed and here are a few notes before we hand over artifacts.

1) Ownership: Priya will be the POC lead here at Horizon (priya.sharma@horizon-analytics.com). I’ll be the technical contact.
2) Timeline: We can aim to upload the prompt set and anonymized logs by EOD Wed, Mar 18. We should be able to get at least ~600 sample interactions.
3) Redaction / compliance: We need a short checklist we can run on our side. Can you confirm whether Redwood requires tokenization vs full removal of names? Also whether there’s a preferred schema for expected_output_optional?

We are attaching a preliminary draft of the prompt set so you can validate format and give feedback. Also — do you have an S3 pre-signed upload option or do you prefer secure Drive? Some of our infra folks prefer S3 for larger exports.

Jordan Ellis

j.ellis@horizon-analytics.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@horizon-analytics.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@horizon-analytics.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff: Prompt/eval dataset requirements & timeline

Thanks Jordan — perfect. A few clarifications to make ingestion smooth:

- Redaction: Tokenization for direct identifiers is preferred (e.g., replace with [PATIENT_1], [DR_2]). Full removal is acceptable if consistent. Please avoid changing clinical phrasing that is necessary for evaluation (symptoms, medications, lab references).
- Formats we accept: CSV, CSV with quoted fields, or JSONL (one JSON per line). For expected outputs, the CSV column expected_output_optional can be empty when you don't have a gold output; we will still score based on heuristics and human spot checks.
- Upload options: S3 pre-signed bucket is easiest for files >10MB; secure Drive link is OK for smaller sets. If you want S3, we can create a short-lived upload link and share with your infra.

Action items on our side: Vivek will validate sample schema and run a quick checksum and schema report within 24 hours of upload. Sean will coordinate an internal kickoff on Mar 19 to walk through results with your team.

Proposed quick schedule:
- Wed Mar 18 (EOD): Horizon uploads artifacts.
- Thu Mar 19 morning: Redwood validates ingestion and we schedule a 30-min kickoff at 10:00 AM PT.

I’ve attached an updated mutual action plan with the owners and timeline; please review and sign off when you can.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: mutual_action_plan_Horizon_POC_v2.docx (DOCX, 16KB)]

From: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@horizon-analytics.com>

Cc: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@horizon-analytics.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff: Prompt/eval dataset requirements & timeline

Marissa — thanks. We uploaded the artifacts to the secure S3 link you provided and added the files below. Please confirm receipt and that the format looks good to your ingestion scripts.

Uploaded artifacts (S3 bucket, presigned links provided to your team):
- horizon_eval_prompts_v1.csv (CSV, ~24KB) — contains 620 prompt rows; columns: prompt_id,prompt_text,expected_output_optional,intent_tag
- sample_logs_redacted.json (JSONL, ~120KB) — 650 lines; names/tokenized as [PATIENT_n] and [PROV_n]; timestamps relative (e.g., "3 days ago")
- mutual_action_plan_Horizon_POC.docx (DOCX, 17KB) — updated sign-off with Priya as owner

We followed your tokenization guidance and left clinical context intact. Our infra did a quick checksum and the files look complete.

Next: please confirm ingestion ETA and let's lock in the kickoff at Thu, Mar 19 10:00 AM PT. Also let us know if you need any additional metadata fields attached to the logs (e.g., model_version, endpoint_id) — we can append a small manifest if helpful.
